arguments.text: 6000 m, legs 1250 m out-and-back (4.8 legs). Goal: even effort near pod sustainable shaft power (~175 W; pod CP 169 W, reserve 16 kJ, test may be 10-25 pct off). Let the hard start settle by ~3 min; if shaft power still well above ~180 W after that, ease. Mid-race (around 2000-3500 m) consider a short piece to test whether CP is higher or lower (HR trend at a fixed effort). Watch for incidents: speed loss at steady pod power (weed, drag), pod vs GPS mismatch (pod drift), radio messages (course changes). Finish sprint from about 400-600 m to go depending on reserve.

Either pod reads low since ~130 s or lower rate is more efficient. HR 170, trend +1 bpm/min at 150-195 s. Paddler says 5/10, plenty. Pod reserve 37 pct. Test: watch HR trend at steady ~185 W pod 190-330 s; levels off -> CP likely higher than 169; keeps climbing -> CP right, ease.

CP pod now believed ~183 W (176-192; test said 169, too low), pod reserve ~46 pct at 715 s. Rudder fouling cleared at 645 s. Plan: hold ~CP (183-187 W pod) on leg 3 (out, 2500-3750 m); on leg 4 (back, into current, from 3750 m = 2250 to go) ask a +4 to +5 pct piece for about 300 s (more power where the boat is slow); finish: from ~700 m to go start the sprint if reserve allows (pod reserve > 30 pct), else 400-500 m. Watch: drag step (push_local - push_along below -0.07: back-stroke), forced pod drop (reserve empty: then CP lower, ease), HR climbing > 1 bpm/min at steady effort (CP lower).
